trial_reasoning: Confirmatory, not selective: the arm, the lag, the Policy thresholds, the regularisation procedure and the Cost Scenario were all frozen in the Experiment Contract before this ran, and ADR-0018 forbids the number influencing anything afterwards — a defect found later is disclosed or the claim is withdrawn, never re-run. A Trial is an evaluation whose result could have changed a choice; this one has none left to change, so it spends none.
